title: What needs changing when a 7-metre bogie-hearth furnace is extended to 10 metres?
summary: Extending a bogie-hearth furnace requires more than another section of steel shell. Suneng's 2019 retrofit proposal increases effective working length from 7 m to 10 m, adding a bogie section, wheels, seals, 300 kW of heating and two control zones, followed by retesting of the complete furnace. The review must cover integration of both new and existing structures and controls.
